plan.title: Persona P3: memory delta, collapse merge, conflict list
plan.goal: Instances write tagged memory deltas; the local harness merges them into canonical memory with provenance; conflicting facts reach the owner to the owner through the agent in the CLI and are never last-write-wins
success_criteria: A fact learned in one lane is recalled by another lane after one collapse (real lanes)
A conflicting fact from two lanes is put to the owner in the CLI, not silently overwritten
Coordinator or attention-queue failure never loses a delta or resolves a conflict silently

phases.name: Design check
phases.goal: Independent review of DESIGN.md before build

phases.name: Build and activate
phases.goal: Delta route, collapse, conflict executor, live E2E

items.name: Design and independent review
items.goal: Frozen design for delta schema, collapse merge, conflict list
items.validation_goal: Review receipt from a lane different from the author; open questions 1-6 answered

items.name: Delta route and client
items.goal: POST /api/memory/delta with instance-tagged facts, redaction, pending-deltas fallback; memory_delta.py helper
items.validation_goal: Acceptance tests 1, 6, 8 pass against the live coordinator

items.name: Collapse merge
items.goal: MemoryCrystallizer.collapse with collapsed_deltas idempotence, corroboration, disputed state, supersession off for deltas
items.validation_goal: Acceptance tests 4, 5 pass; existing test_memory_crystallizer tests still pass

items.name: Conflicts asked in the CLI
items.goal: Delta reply returns conflicts; agent asks the owner; resolutions applied via the same route; disputed shown at session start

items.name: Activation attestation
items.goal: Rule 15 attestation: integrated, ON, validated end to end, observable, intervenable
items.validation_goal: Cross-lane recall and conflict listing demonstrated with real Claude, Codex and local lanes
